items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: we all went to Carroll Dickerson's house, our whole band. Louis Armstrong and our whole band.

ctx.x: There must have been something. Because we had heard their first broadcast in Chicago when Duke made that coast to coast hook up like you know. And Bubber Miley was in the band at that time because we all went to Carroll Dickerson's house, our

whole band. Louis Armstrong and our whole band. We went over to Carroll Cat Dickerson's house to hear this broadcast. It was coming in in the afternoon like. It was sort of like a special deal. And old Bubber Miley played East St. Louis Teedle-oo Blues. Boy, he sure did growl and go on and on.
Well he was really the strongest thing in the band to begin with wasn't he?
